links.name: GuidelineTitle
links.quote: Inhaler Technique Review for Adults With Asthma

links.name: CommitteeExpertise
links.quote: two nurses, one pharmacist and one physician

links.name: InclusionCriterion
links.quote: adults aged 18 years or older with a diagnosis of asthma who use an inhaler

links.name: ExclusionCriterion
links.quote: people who use a nebuliser only

links.name: Recommendation
links.quote: A nurse or pharmacist should watch the patient use their inhaler at every asthma review.

links.name: Directive
links.quote: watch the patient use their inhaler at every asthma review

links.name: Recommendation
links.quote: If the patient makes an error in technique, the clinician should demonstrate the correct technique and ask the patient to repeat it.

links.name: DecisionVariable
links.quote: the patient makes an error in technique

links.name: Action
links.quote: demonstrate the correct technique and ask the patient to repeat it

links.name: Recommendation
links.quote: If the patient cannot use a pressurised metered-dose inhaler correctly after teaching, the clinician should offer a spacer.

links.name: DecisionVariable
links.quote: the patient cannot use a pressurised metered-dose inhaler correctly after teaching

links.name: TermMeaning
links.quote: A holding chamber attached to a metered-dose inhaler.

links.name: TermMeaning
links.quote: A planned visit to assess control, treatment and technique.
